vtable.extent_evidence: The ROM holds 32 consecutive function pointers from the address point at 0x0211d0ec through 0x0211d168. The following word at 0x0211d16c is 0x0211208c, a pointer into the shared 0x02112xxx resource region that no symbols.txt attributes to ov065 and that is not a function pointer, so 0x0211d16c is the exclusive end and the emitted preamble-plus-slots storage is exactly 0x88 bytes. tools/rtti_vtables.py reports 34 slots for this class; the two extra entries are that following table read as slots -- the known _ZTV extent overrun, not this class's storage. tubuild verify independently reports the emitted _ZTV section at size 0x88, which corroborates 32.
vtable.slot_name_note: Names are inherited interface labels from include/dActor_c.h and include/dBgActor_c.h, or ABI destructor labels. The ROM proves slot identity and target address; it does not preserve those English spellings.
vtable.inherited_slots_note: Slots 1,2,4,5,7,8,10-15,18-30 resolve to arm9 dActor_c/fBase_c bodies and slot 31 to ov002 _ZN10dBgActor_c4KillEv, so this class overrides nothing else and adds no new virtual. Slot 31 present at all is what makes the table 32 words rather than dActor_c's 31: the dBgActor_c length rule.
vtable.destructor_order: D1 at 0x02119f3c precedes D0 at 0x02119f88 in the cartridge. That is the order mwccarm 2004/b56 produces from an INLINE in-class virtual destructor; the out-of-line form gives D2,D0,D1 plus a homeless D2. No subset licensing is needed for this class.

size.evidence: The class factory (historical placeholder func_ov065_0211a45c) calls fBase_c::operator new with the literal 0x388, read off the retail instruction. A field span is only a lower bound; this literal is the size.

layout.inherited_through: dBgActor_c, which ends its own data at 0x31e and rounds to 0x320

own_fields.name: mSwingDir
own_fields.evidence: InitResources seeds 1; Behavior negates it whenever its sign agrees with mSwingAngle.

own_fields.name: mSwingAccel
own_fields.evidence: InitResources loads data_ov065_0211c0b0[data_0209f2c0]; Behavior re-rolls it to 0xd or 0x2a under setting 2.

own_fields.name: mSwingAngle
own_fields.evidence: InitResources seeds 0x1964 and copies it into dActor_c::mAngleZ; Behavior accumulates mSwingSpeed into it.

own_fields.name: mSwingSpeed
own_fields.evidence: Behavior accumulates mSwingAccel * mSwingDir into it.

own_fields.name: mSoundTimer
own_fields.evidence: DecIfAbove0_Short target; at 0 plays bank-3 sound 0x38 at the actor's camera-space position, and is reloaded as mPauseTimer + 0xf.

own_fields.name: mPauseTimer
own_fields.evidence: DecIfAbove0_Short target that gates the whole swing update; reseeded from the random draw.

own_fields.name: ground Y (unnamed in the header, inside pad_32a)
own_fields.evidence: func_ov065_02119fe8 writes the probe Y there, then overwrites it with dBgCh_Gnd::clsnY on a hit, then shifts it into the shadow matrix translation row.

own_fields.name: mShadowModel
own_fields.evidence: InitResources calls ShadowModel::InitCuboid on this + 0x330; func_ov065_02119fe8 passes it to dActor_c::DropShadowScaleXYZ. Size 0x28 puts the next field at 0x358.

own_fields.name: shadow matrix (spelled pad_358[0x30] in the header)
own_fields.evidence: func_ov065_02119fe8 builds it with Matrix4x3_FromRotationY, writes 0x37c/0x380/0x384 (m[9..11], the translation row) and hands it to DropShadowScaleXYZ. 0x358 + 0x30 = 0x388, exactly the factory's allocation literal.

unproven: func_ov065_02119fe8 and func_ov065_0211a114 have no ROM-preserved names. config/arm9/overlays/ov065/symbols.txt spells both by address, so the promotion keeps those spellings and leaves them extern "C" free functions rather than inventing member names. Their bodies, signatures as used, and call sites are proven; their original identifiers, member-versus-free form, and parameter types are not.

The header's field names (mSwingDir, mSwingAccel, mSwingAngle, mSwingSpeed, mSoundTimer, mPauseTimer) are descriptive reconstructions. Offsets, widths, and the arithmetic relating them are ROM-proven; the English spellings are not.

0x32a..0x32b and the 0x358 matrix are still spelled as padding in include/daObjCtMecha03_c.h. The evidence above supports naming them, but this promotion deliberately did not, so that no field-address CSE lever changed underneath a byte-verified body.

data_ov035_02112198 is the CLPS_Block passed to dBgW_KcMbg::SetFile. Eleven overlays declare an ambiguous symbol at that address; tools/overlay_residency.py settles it to ov035 as the only one able to coexist with ov065. That settlement is a residency argument, not a direct ROM fact.
boundary_confidence is medium on both sides, and the module sinit corroboration is module-wide (10 sinits / 10 .ctor entries), not narrowed to this TU.
